name: smwgraphics-small-dragon-coin-yoshi-coin
title: Small Dragon Coin/Yoshi Coin
description:
These set of graphics with instructions makes your Dragon Coins 16x16 for your game.

There are two GFX files for slot 14 (in hex) - a flashing variant and non flashing variant.

The 16x16 edit won't show in LM, but you can help yourself by replacing it manually in LM in conjunction with the hack. Enjoy!!!
